selection.title: Basic failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA)

frozen_authoritative_identity.note: Supplemental public sources explain FMEA mechanics but do not replace or broaden the frozen CSSGB requirement identity.

supplemental_public_sources.role: Defines FMEA as a systematic method to identify potential failure modes, analyze effects, and prioritize risk; distinguishes the way a function fails from consequences.
Current public FMECA guidance supporting the function/failure-mode/effect/cause/detection/mitigation separation and iterative living-risk-analysis model.

supplemental_public_sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supplemental_public_sources.role: Public information-model evidence for explicit relationships among subject, function, requirement, failure mode, effect, cause, prevention, detection and risk fields.

use_constraints: Do not reproduce proprietary ASQ Body of Knowledge text beyond the frozen requirement identity already preserved in the repository.
Do not infer certification equivalence, SME approval, psychometric validity or curriculum effectiveness from supplemental sources.
Do not invent severity, occurrence, detection, cause, action or prioritization values not supplied by a bounded fixture.

learning_contract.objective: Given a bounded design or process example, identify a supported failure mode and its effect, keep those concepts distinct, and analyze what risk evidence is needed before any improvement response is selected.
observable_success: names the supported function or process step
identifies one supported failure mode as the way the function or step fails
identifies its separately supported effect as the consequence
states which risk or causal evidence remains missing before prioritization or action selection
abstention_conditions: the scenario lacks a function or process-step boundary
the alleged failure mode is only an effect
the alleged effect is not supported by an observed consequence
prioritization is requested without the necessary rating/evidence context
a cause or corrective action is requested without supporting evidence

minimum_cases.shape: explicit function + observed loss of function + downstream consequence; no ratings
process step + defect description + customer consequence + supplied severity only
minimum_cases.expected: identify mode/effect/severity evidence; do not invent occurrence or detection

minimum_cases.shape: effect-only narrative with no supported way-of-failure
mode and effect supplied but proposed action has no cause evidence
minimum_cases.expected: analyze supported chain; refuse action-effectiveness claim

invariants: failure_mode and effect are independently evidenced and nonempty
action_selection_supported is false when required risk or cause evidence is absent
course answer text cannot alter oracle correctness
real learner mastery is never emitted by fixture execution
metamorphic_properties: swapping a supported mode and effect must fail role checks
removing consequence evidence must force effect abstention
removing risk context must not change mode/effect identification but must force prioritization abstention
adding irrelevant narrative must not change supported field extraction
meaning-preserving paraphrase must preserve the evidence relation and score
